title: Refinery background-source manifest
description: Reference contract for sources/<name>/manifest.yml. NOTE: no automated validator runs in the pipeline — ingest.py reads manifests directly; this file documents the expected shape for authors and reviewers.

name.description: Registry key, matches the sources/<name>/ dir.

citable.description: Whether the source's own URLs may seed a GEM [ref] (still re-verified). GEM-authored datasets: false. Documentation-only today — enforcement is url_verifier.py's host blocklist.

mergeable.description: May merge.py include this source in --sources? false = OVERLAY-ONLY (e.g. irs_rcn, gem_gci): reviewed via build_reconciliation_review.py, never merged into the main. merge.py hard-fails on mergeable: false.

location.description: Where the raw data lives. One of file_path / drive_file_id / url / sibling_path.

sibling_path.description: Path relative to the gem repos root, e.g. ../refineries-tracker/refineries.json

layer.description: Layer name for gpkg/geojson multi-layer files (geopandas read_file).

coords_url.description: Adapter-specific: companion GIS layer URL to join coordinates from (e.g. eia).

coords_path.description: Adapter-specific: local path of the downloaded companion coords file.

page.description: Human landing page for the dataset (provenance; not fetched).

id_field.description: Source column that is its stable primary key.

column_map.description: canonical_field -> source_column_name (or a dotted path for nested json). Required only when there is no adapter — an adapter emits canonical-keyed rows itself.

capacity_units.description: Default units for the capacity column if the source doesn't carry a units column (e.g. 'bpd' for RMI).

status_map.description: source status value -> controlled Status vocab value (case-insensitive keys).

configuration_map.description: source config code/value -> controlled Configuration vocab value (e.g. H -> hydroskimming; case-insensitive keys).

start_year_sentinels.description: Years that mean 'unknown' in the source and are nulled at ingest (default: [1900], OGIM's placeholder).

defaults.description: Constant fills for a scoped source: canonical_field -> value applied when the row leaves it null (e.g. china_rmi_tracker sets country/iso3).

adapter.description: Optional python module (adapter.py) with a parse() for custom formats. When set, column_map is not required.
